biography: Judge Sava Wren is a 61-year-old Half-Elf magistrate known around the magistrate's bench. Day to day, Judge makes eye contact with the poorest person first, and keeps gavel with a softened rim close at hand. Peer to Mayor; works with Crowe and Merrick. Locals who deal with them learn quickly what matters: they fear nobles buying outcomes through festival gifts, and they hope to set a precedent that ledgers bind lords too. In conversation they are practical first and poetic only when it helps. A DM can put them on stage immediately as a source of work, rumor, or shelter. Current hook: Asked Merrick for a clean chain of evidence on Rook before festival court.
